questions.question: Sarai Nahar Rai, a Mesolithic site, is located in _____.

The Government of India has launched a new Centrally Sponsored Scheme, namely 'New India Literacy Programme' (NILP), for implementation during the five years from FY  _____________.
Where was the first Asian Inclusive Sailing Series (AISS) held in October 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (KRS Dam, Mysuru) है।

questions.question: How many total medals did India win at the Asian Aquatics Championships 2025?

In June 2024, to enhance road safety, NHAI signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with which of the following institutes to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) based solutions for improvement in the availability of road signs on National Highways?
options: Indian Institute of Information Technology, Lucknow
International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad
Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology, Delhi) है।

questions.question: Which of the following Vedas mentions Arya Varna and Dasa Varna?
What significant reform was introduced under the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025, passed in April 2025?
options: Inclusion of non-Muslims in Waqf management boards
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Inclusion of non-Muslims in Waqf management boards) है।

questions.question: During summer, localised thunderstorms are associated with violent winds and torrential downpours and are often accompanied by hail. In ______, these storms are known as the Kaal Baisakhi.

Thaipusam is a significant festival for which deity in Tamil Hindu tradition?

Which of the following statements correctly describes the e-rupee introduced by the Reserve Bank of India?
options: It is a UPI-based platform for bank transfers only.
It is India’s Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC).
It is a digital token issued by commercial banks.
It is a private cryptocurrency with no RBI backing.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (It is India’s Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC).) है।

questions.question: Which of the following technologies helps detect genetic abnormalities in foetuses using small fragments of DNA in maternal blood?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT)) है।
